items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: We had, uh, Count Basie, uh, Artie Shaw, Benny Goodman. They were absolute replicas of these guys and he put on these things and he'd conduct them.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. You weren't there for just a day, obviously.

No, I was there for quite a few. We were there on, we started with Victor Records and then we went on another album, another company. We did a lot of, we did Studebaker transcriptions, a lot of stuff with Studebaker transcriptions. Well I think I was on drums most of those. You see he changed the style of the band every once in a while. He started off with this sort of bell tone band. You know, Bing-Bong, you know what the trumpet players, it's this band that if you played together you were wrong. Played pyramids…
Yeah, I'll, it's the one with the, uh, this must be the third edition, huh?
